name: reconstruct-paper-figures
summary: Traceable reconstruction of paper figures as editable SVG, Illustrator AI, and editable PDF while preserving scientific raster evidence.

capabilities.description: Inventory native PDF text, vectors, images, placements, captions, and effective PPI before reconstruction.
Rebuild editable vectors and live text while preserving continuous-tone scientific evidence as minimal atomic rasters.
Bind publisher observations and reconstruction semantics to editable statistical figures without synthesizing missing groups.
Convert reviewed OCR decisions into bounded masks, safe non-generative cleanup, independent pixel audit, and live-text overlays.
Audit SVG import, AI reopen, and editable-PDF reopen with object, typography, linked-atom, artboard, and hash persistence evidence.
Produce editable framework geometry for draw.io and Visio while keeping final Illustrator acceptance separate.
